purpose: Single provenance ledger for the four CANNBot-derived environment, custom-op, MindIE Service and CUDA-to-NPU migration units. It records the exact inspected snapshots, the public vendor contracts used where the requested CANNBot paths were absent, the execution receipts that support the reproduced_empirical unit, and the evidence limits of each unit.

unit-ascend-cann-driver-and-torch-npu-ab.basis: CANNBot environment/platform guides, the official TorchNPU compatibility table and the CANN/firmware compatibility entry points.
unit-ascend-cann-driver-and-torch-npu-ab.limits: The axioms define required compatibility evidence and failure attribution. They do not claim a specific host passed a live NPU run, nor that a healthy npu-smi output proves ABI or kernel-package compatibility.

unit-torch-npu-custom-op-registration-an.basis: CANNBot PTA route documentation, direct-invoke/aclnn registration templates, Meta/FakeTensor rules, plus vendor-symbol and ACLNN regression receipts.
unit-torch-npu-custom-op-registration-an.limits: The SOP is not a correctness proof for every custom operator. It establishes route, symbol, schema, Meta and tracing preconditions; numerical acceptance remains an operator-specific test.

unit-mindie-service-config-security-and-.basis: Public MindIE Service configuration, security and startup pages plus a MindIE-compatible deployment sample for the config field family and semantics.
unit-mindie-service-config-security-and-.limits: Exact field names, valid ranges, log paths and default values vary by MindIE release. The SOP requires reading the installed release's schema rather than assuming one version's ranges.

unit-pytorch-cuda-to-torch-npu-serving-m.basis: A synthesis of live A3 service receipts (896/896 requests, ACLGraph decode), a live A5 FlashMLA C8 ACLGraph qualification, live A2/A5 FLA AscendC validation and a live ACLNN custom-op regression. The causal-conv1d port supplies the binding/Meta source pattern.
unit-pytorch-cuda-to-torch-npu-serving-m.limits: This is a multi-run reproduction of the workflow stages, not one CUDA model migrated end-to-end in a single controlled experiment. It does not establish a universal speedup, universal operator coverage or numerical parity for an arbitrary model.

privacy.rule: Only repository-relative source paths, commit identifiers, public URLs and aggregate measurements are retained.
